context: The VFUNARY1 and VMUNARY0 encoding spaces in the RISC-V V extension list vector instructions including vfsqrt.v, vfrsqrt7.v, vfrec7.v, vfclass.v, vmsbf, vmsof, vmsif, viota, and vid with their respective vs1 field encodings.
